create_series_data: create a list of pandas Series with various patterns including NaN, constant, increasing, and decreasing values
create_dataframes_from_series: create pandas DataFrames from existing Series and add DataFrames with duplicate column names
check_data_consistency: check if a pandas Series or DataFrame has a single non-NaN constant value across all elements
build_consistent_data_fixture: build a pytest fixture that yields only constant-value Series and DataFrames for parameterized tests
build_all_data_fixture: build a pytest fixture that yields empty, NaN, constant, monotonic, and NaN-mixed Series and DataFrames
